skills.delivery_notes: swing weapon(s) in a 180-degree frontal arc damaging everything in front; dual-wield hits 60% per weapon combined. melee_arc is the purpose-built 'wide frontal melee swing' type — a lossless fit. physical -> no element family; bleed is the native physical-swing ailment substrate. base radius 20u -> +1m at gem 20 is a numeric range

mapping_json.motion_frame: jump-in-and-swing bruiser: leap into the pack, sweep the 180-degree frontal arc, stack Fortify off hits; Multistrike repeats the swing three times
mapping_json.fidelity_notes: The cleanest map in the batch. melee_arc IS the Cleave identity — a wide frontal-cone swing — and the engine type exists precisely for it. physical -> no element family (crosswalk §1); bleed carries the physical-swing ailment flavor; dual-wield 60%/weapon + 80% attack-speed + base-radius scaling are all NUMERIC tuning, not identity-mechanisms. Nothing identity-bearing is lost. NOTE per batch instruction: the stage-1 negative_canon claim ('extrinsic-no-lever: no meaningful scaling lever vs Blade Flurry/Cyclone, fell off without a hard nerf') is UNSUPPORTED (verify_ledger) AND is an inference-not-attested meta-economy observation — I do NOT treat it as verified fact, and it maps to no engine MECHANISM regardless (a 'lacks a scaling lever' judgement is a balance-meta claim about the source ecosystem, not a mechanic the engine must represent). Grade reflects only the attested mechanics. Multistrike (thrice-repeat) is a geometry/cadence support; Fortify-on-hit is a def-bin/trait rider (Champion variant).
